LESSON: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: When do we use interjections in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify interjections in texts for comprehension
2. use interjections in oral paragraphs for expression
3. appreciate the role of interjections in expressing emotion in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension for Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify interjections in texts for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use interjections in oral paragraphs for expression
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of interjections in expressing emotion in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension above.
2. Explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When do we use interjections in sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify interjections in texts for comprehension
2. use interjections in oral paragraphs for expression
3. appreciate the role of interjections in expressing emotion in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
